notes: All GPU measurements used Apple M3 Metal hardware.
Experimental FPS runs are exploratory; final-baseline and final-merged-native contain three repeated runs per scene.
Only geometry with sidedness-and-source-facing-v2 is included; older CPU reference results are superseded.
Self-reference RMSE is not full physical GI truth.
Original /tmp screenshots and full records are not committed.
